title: Action-Plan Share Schedule by Level and Listing Violation History (Seller Performance Standing)
content:
The share of covered points that an action-plan relief takes off depends on the seller's Seller Performance Standing level and on how many listing policy or restricted product violations the seller has had in the past year.

**Share.** The action-plan share is the high action-plan share of 0.35 (35%) for a seller placed at Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level with at most two listing policy or restricted product violations recorded in the last twelve whole calendar months, and the middle action-plan share of 0.3 (30%) for a seller placed at Standard Level, Developing Seller Level or Below Standard Level with at most two such violations recorded in that period. A seller with three or more such violations recorded in that period takes neither of these shares.

## The count

The count takes every violation recorded with the type listing policy or the type restricted product, the two types together, in the last twelve whole calendar months. Whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date: a violation lies in the period when fewer than twelve whole months have passed from its recording date to the handling date. Violations of the other four types do not enter the count.

## Schedule

| Level the seller is placed at | Listing policy and restricted product violations in the period | Action-plan share |
|---|---|---|
| Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level, Preferred Partner Level | 0, 1 or 2 | 0.35 |
| Standard Level, Developing Seller Level, Below Standard Level | 0, 1 or 2 | 0.3 |
| any level | 3 or more | neither share in this schedule |

## Both sides of the count (hypothetical sellers)

- Top Rated Level, one listing policy and one restricted product violation in the period (two in all): 0.35.
- Top Rated Level, two listing policy and one restricted product violation in the period (three in all): neither 0.35 nor 0.3.
- Standard Level, two listing policy violations and one intellectual property violation in the period: the count is two, so 0.3.

**Worked figure.** Covered points of 6 multiplied by 0.35 give 2.1000, rounded down to 2; multiplied by 0.3 they give 1.8000, rounded down to 1.
